ARCHITECTURE_VERDICT: CONDITIONAL_REJECT_OF_SPEC_AS_WRITTEN. ACCEPT a smaller primitive: actor-owned append-only OUTBOX + dispatcher-only INBOX copies + ACK packets. Reject shared-write mailboxes, processed-file moves, Issues-as-authority, presence-as-coordination-truth, and generated inbox markdown as anything but disposable views.

FATAL_FLAWS.detail: If every actor can push the same private repo, anyone can plant a file in executive-reviewer/inbox or forge executive-reviewer/outbox. A folder named mailbox is not ownership. Git write access is global unless CODEOWNERS + protected branches + Action-only inbox writes.
Moving a packet from inbox/ to processed/ is a mutation, races under concurrent git pull/push, and lets a reader rewrite history of what was received. ACK must be a new packet, never a move.

generated/inbox/*.md and GitHub Issues will be what humans actually read. Without an explicit demotion law they become task lists, replacing .ai-os. That is how Team Relay becomes execution/control truth.
A second repo invites copying receipts, WAL slices, and Repair paths into envelopes. Then the hub is a shadow evidence store. Envelopes may carry refs and hashes only.

SECURITY_FLAWS: Git author/committer strings are spoofable. MVP identity = GitHub username bound by an allowlist in the hub, plus protected main, no force-push, signed commits preferred.

A stolen MAIN_ASSISTANT token must not be able to delete Repair files. write_authority:false is necessary but insufficient unless the executor refuses to honor requested_actions without a live .ai-os lock it owns.
Replaying a destructive envelope with a new packet_id bypasses packet_id dedupe. Need expires_at + requested_head + explicit USER/executor rebase packet.
Inbox injection: if actors can write other inboxes, a stale/compromised consultant injects 'EXECUTE DELETE'. Dispatcher-only inbox write is mandatory.
Secrets in envelopes. Hub is less trusted than Repair. No tokens, no WAL bodies, no customer records, no absolute Windows paths.
AUTHORITY_CONFLICTS: RELAY_PACKET_NE_TASK — packet cannot create or complete a .ai-os task.
RELAY_NE_LOCK — presence.json must not substitute LOCKS.json.
RELAY_NE_HANDOFF — GitHub Issue is not D-003 handoff.
RELAY_NE_ORCHESTRATION — mailbox round-trip is not GL-005.
DELIVERY_RECEIPT_NE_EXECUTION_RECEIPT — already proposed; keep it fail-closed with no PASS boolean on envelopes.
LEARNING_CANDIDATE_NE_CANONICAL — relay must not write Cognitive WAL as authority; only an internal adapter may submit DISCOVERED candidates.
BOARD_ALREADY_EXISTS — .ai-os/board/NOW.md is the in-repo meeting point. A hub before C2 uses the board is platform-before-primitive.
RACE_CONDITIONS: Two ACKs for one packet_id: last writer of generated views wins; packets themselves are fine if immutable and named by packet_id.
Cursor and Reviewer both respond on one correlation_id: ALLOWED. Do not serialize the conversation with a single lock on the hub. .ai-os locks serialize Repair writes only.
Dispatcher copies to inbox while recipient pulls: git merge on generated markdown. Do not commit generated views. Recipients generate locally.
presence.json overwrite: inevitable. Therefore presence is advisory and untrusted.
PROTOCOL_CHANGES: Actors may write ONLY mailboxes/<self>/outbox/<packet_id>.json. Never another actor's inbox, outbox, or processed.
A GitHub Action (the dispatcher) validates, authenticates allowlist, dedupes packet_id, copies to recipient inbox, writes delivery-receipts/<packet_id>.json as actor RELAY.
No processed/ directory. ACK/REJECT/STALE/EXECUTED are new packets in the actor's own outbox with causation_id set.
No generated/*.md in git. Local `raios-board.py`-class renderer only.
GitHub Issues optional and non-authoritative. Issue body may link blob SHA of the envelope. If Issue and envelope disagree, envelope wins for machines; USER wins for direction.
Envelopes forbid fields: pass, certified, gl004_proven, gl005_proven as booleans. Those live only in Repair receipts.
Destructive envelopes require requested_head, expires_at, and evidence_refs. Missing any → REJECT.
Keep using .ai-os/board as degraded/offline meeting point. Hub is optional external transport, not the control plane.
MAILBOX_STATE_MACHINE: SEEN (optional READ ack packet by recipient)
if ACCEPTED and actor is executor with live lock: EXECUTED_REF | FAILED_REF (refs Repair receipt sha256)

ACK_STATE_MACHINE.STALE_HEAD: recipient or dispatcher; requires new packet
ACK_STATE_MACHINE.EXECUTED: forbidden on relay; only Repair receipt ref from executor outbox

ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.USER: direction; destructive approval; may ACCEPT risk
ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.MAIN_ASSISTANT: steer/synthesize/challenge; write_authority false; cannot complete .ai-os tasks
ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.EXECUTIVE_REVIEWER: falsify claims; write_authority false; cannot delete; cannot grant GL-004/GL-005
ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.CURSOR_EXECUTOR: write Repair only under .ai-os locks it holds; may emit execution receipt refs
ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.ENGINEER: run scripts on Repair; same lock rules; no policy
ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.RAIOS: observe; DISCOVERED learning candidates only; no promotion; no execution
ACTOR_CAPABILITY_MODEL.RELAY: validate/route/dedupe/receipt delivery; never execute; never write WAL

OFFLINE_BEHAVIOR.when_hub_returns: push unpublished outbox packets; reject those past expires_at or with stale requested_head

GITHUB_MVP_VERDICT: CONDITIONAL_YES for a private hub that stores ONLY envelopes and delivery receipts, with CODEOWNERS so each actor can push only their outbox, and a GitHub Action that is the only writer of inboxes. CONDITIONAL_NO for GitHub Issues as meeting-room authority, git-tracked generated inboxes, presence as coordination, processed/ moves, and copying Repair receipts into the hub.
WHAT_NOT_TO_BUILD: five mailbox trees before C2 has used .ai-os/board
MINIMUM_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN: 0. Use .ai-os/board NOW.md as the meeting point until C2 has posted one opinion. Do not open a hub with zero users.
1. If external reach is still required: create empty private repo RAIOS-Team-Hub with CODEOWNERS + branch protection + packet schema file only.
2. Allowlist: github_username → actor_id. Unsigned commits from unknown users rejected by Action.
3. Actor publishes only outbox/<packet_id>.json. Action copies to inbox/<to>/ and writes delivery-receipts/<packet_id>.json.
4. Local renderer (extend raios-board.py later) lists PENDING for WHOAMI. Views not committed.
5. Repair adapter: read inbox as DISCOVERED suggestions. To act: claim .ai-os task, re-check HEAD vs requested_head, then execute. Never the reverse.
6. Stop. Prove 20 packets, one stale-head reject, one replay reject, one forged-inbox reject. Then consider Issues as optional links.

CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.1_duplicate_authority: Yes, as written. Views, Issues, presence, processed/, and requested_actions will become a shadow OS. Demote them in the protocol or do not build them.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.2_races: Allow concurrent packets on one correlation. Forbid mutating shared files. Generate views locally.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.3_semantic_idempotency: Dedupe packet_id only. Ten challenges in one correlation are ten packets.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.4_stale_head: Fail-closed STALE_HEAD. No auto-rebase. New packet or explicit rebase ack with current head.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.5_git_identity: Insufficient alone. Allowlist GitHub username + protected branch. Commit email is not identity.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.6_injection: Dispatcher-only inbox; write_authority false; executor requires live lock + head match.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.7_replay: packet_id replay no-op; content replay needs new id, then expires_at + requested_head catch it.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.8_mailbox_ownership: Own outbox only. Inbox is dispatcher-written. No processed/.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.9_ack_model: DELIVERED READ ACCEPTED REJECTED STALE EXPIRED. EXECUTED is Repair-only as a ref.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.11_offline_continuity: Yes. Hub is transport. Repair is truth.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.12_privacy: Refs and hashes only. No WAL, secrets, customer data, absolute home paths.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.13_git_scaling: Fine for hundreds. Not an archive. Compact later. Do not design object storage now.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.14_human_machine: Envelope authoritative for machines. Issues are commentary. USER authoritative for direction.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.15_cross_env_identity: Stable actor_id. Environment is metadata (repair|workspace|kaggle). Bind github_user separately.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.16_trust_levels: Yes. Distinct capability contracts above. Reviewer cannot grant PASS.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.17_learning_injection: External packet → DISCOVERED candidate only, via internal WAL adapter, never CANONICAL.
CHALLENGE_ANSWERS.18_wave2: Relay must not satisfy GL-005. Optional evidence_ref to task_id. Tasks still claimed in .ai-os.
